build_MMDetBackbone: build an MMDetBackbone wrapper from an mmdet config dict with output shapes and optional neck
build_MMDetDetector: build an MMDetDetector wrapper from an mmdet config dict with pixel normalization parameters
run_MMDetBackbone_forward: run the MMDetBackbone forward pass on an image tensor and return a dict of feature tensors
run_MMDetDetector_forward: run the MMDetDetector forward pass on batched inputs for training or inference with detection results
convert_mmdet_result_to_Instances: convert an mmdet detection result tuple into a detectron2 Instances object with boxes scores and masks
